units: x y w h = atlas px (top-left origin; Unity Rect(x, H - y - h, w, h)); pivot = the clip / canvas pivot relative to the TRIMMED rect (may lie outside 0..1); scale = raster px per design px, sprite ppu = ppu * scale; ox oy = trimmed rect offset from the bottom-left of the full canvas cw x ch (stored px); layers: x y w h = where the layer sits on the 1080 x 1920 home canvas (design px, bottom-left origin), parallax factor, z order

fx_crane_grab.use: crane booster claw open -> closed; release = play backwards (event at frame 2: release); rope = crane_band style tiled sprite, descent / carry are tweens (JUICE #62, 900 ms total)

fx_hammer_smash.use: hammer swings in from the right -60 -> +20 deg, impact at 6, recoil (JUICE #61, 450 ms)

fx_impact_star.use: comic impact burst (white core + gold) spawned at the hammer impact

fx_paint_splash.use: brush colour swap splash on each block (JUICE #63, 500 ms); rendered white

fx_trowel_sparkle.use: golden trowel turning +-15 deg with glints: combo icon (#16), trowel flight head (#17)

fx_coin_spin.use: coin turning 360 deg around its vertical axis; frame 0 = icon_coin face (#56, #74)

fx_star_burst.use: ring + 16 small stars radial behind the earned star (#96, 600 ms)

fx_confetti3d_rect.use: 3D flip cycle of a paper rectangle; rendered white (#55, #18)

fx_confetti3d_round.use: 3D flip cycle of a paper disc; rendered white

fx_segment_done.use: segment complete flare + ring + sparkles behind the site; the segment flight to the panorama is a tween (#18, #93, 600 ms)

fx_lock_shine.use: correct placement glint on each stud, additive white, staggered 40 ms bottom -> top over the cells (#12, #92, 200 ms)
